actions.description: Send MeetGeek's notetaker into a meeting now. MeetGeek's bot joins a live online meeting (Google Meet, Zoom, Teams) right away, records it and makes its notes. Paid plans only. Not in MeetGeek's published spec, so its fields follow Composio's.

meeting_name.description: A title for the meeting, instead of the one MeetGeek makes up
